headline: New test: sparse selected series over wide head yields one block
reason: New test-only function that adds coverage and cannot affect production behavior.
summary: Adds TestCompactSelectedSeries_SparseSelectedAcrossWideHead. A filler series pushes head.MaxTime far past the selected series, and the test asserts CompactSelectedSeries writes exactly one block, in memory and on disk, with the selected-series hint. It is a new test with no production code, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
